name: Spotify Integration
author: plexescor
description: Displays currently playing Spotify track in HPR topbar and logs listening history.
longDescription:
### Features
- Real-time **Spotify playback status** integration.
- Logs listening history directly into HPR analytics timeline.
- Automatic album art and track metadata fetching.

name: Dracula Theme
author: dracula
description: Official dark theme for HPR inspired by the famous Dracula color scheme.
longDescription:
### Theme Highlights
- Vibrant **gothic dark tones** (`#282a36`).
- High-contrast neon accents for text and stats.
- Full support for all HPR dashboard components.

name: Pomodoro Timer & Tracker
author: dev-community
description: Integrated Pomodoro timer synchronized with HPR focus session analytics.
longDescription:
### Workflow Enhancement
- Standard **25m focus / 5m break** intervals.
- Syncs focus periods with HPR activity charts.
- Audio notifications upon interval completion.

name: Catppuccin Mocha Theme
author: catppuccin
description: Soothing pastel theme for HPR featuring Catppuccin Mocha palette.
longDescription:
### Palette Overview
- Soothing **warm pastel colors**.
- Easy on the eyes for late night coding.
- Custom styled borders and card elevation shadows.
